title: Machine Learning Assisted Real-Time Label-Free SERS Diagnoses of Malignant Pleural Effusion due to Lung Cancer.
summary: PLS-DA classifies SERS spectra from malignant lung-cancer versus control pleural fluid; Methods describes spectra and classifier, Results reports measured diagnostic performance. Results reports 85% accuracy, 87% sensitivity, 83% specificity, AUC 0.93 on study samples; validation is within-cohort and narrow.
